[모멘텀 지표]

· Current price ($1.30) vs SMA5 ($1.33)/SMA20 ($1.42)/SMA50 ($1.42): short-term bearish, below mid-term resistance
· Position vs SMA100 ($1.27)/SMA200 ($1.28): above long-term support, long-term trend weak
· 52-week position (18.2%) + current price range near historical lows
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (37.9→34.4) + entered oversold territory + continued downward momentum
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.0212→-0.0196) + diagnosed slowing improvement + maintaining bearish convergence
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower $1.28, Middle $1.42) + approaching lower band
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($1.28) + based on SMA200 and lower Bollinger Band
· Swing resistance ($1.39) + resistance at EMA10 and Pivot R1
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (No Higher Low, No Lower High): sideways range
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.47x) + low confidence in price movement
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) + conditions for entry: RSI recovery above 50 and confirmation with increased volume required
